summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals, Inc. to disclose its intention to apply for a Commissioner's National Priority Review Voucher if trial data supports a New Drug Application submission for tafenoquine in severe babesiosis by Q1 2028. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is involved. The filing is a forward-looking regulatory update with no special-situation deal terms.
